title: 21 Chanel Court Vacation Rental
meta_description: 21 Chanel Court is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- 6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental- Parking for 4 Vehicles (Garage Access Available)- Six Seater Street Legal Golf Cart Included- Pet Friendly (Additional Fee Applies)- Natural Gas Grill- Exterior Shower- Private Pool with Outside Pool Bathroom (Complimentary Pool Heating Available October 1 - May 1)- Large Screened In Porches- 2 Minute Bike Ride to the Beach (Greenwood Beach Access)- 7 Minute Bike Ride to Seaside DETAILS:Welcome to 21 Chanel Court, a hidden gem in the heart of Seagrove! Framed by lush oaks and stately magnolias, this stunning 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath home captures the essence of coastal charm and luxury. From cozy cafes to unique boutiques, you're just short stroll from the best Seagrove has to offer. Step into effortless elegance on the first floor, where an inviting living area with plush linen sofas flows into a gourmet kitchen outfitted with top-tier appliances and marble countertops. Share meals and laughter around the dining table for eight, or unwind in the serene king master suite with its spa-like bath featuring a double vanity, soaking tub, and glass walk-in shower. Venture upstairs to find a cozy second living area, a king master with an opulent bath, two more king rooms, a queen bedroom, and a nautical-themed bunk room perfect for kids. With a fully-equipped laundry room, you’ll have everything you need for a carefree stay. Out back, relax on the spacious screened porch overlooking a private pool with a tanning ledge for soaking up the Florida sun. Grill up a feast in the outdoor kitchen, or freshen up in the private outdoor bath after a day of fun. Hop on one of the six provided bikes or take the 6-passenger golf cart to the sugar-white sands, Seaside, or over 20 local dining spots just minutes away. Your 30A dream vacation awaits at 21 Chanel Court—a slice of paradise you and your family will cherish forever.
